lark.title: Lark branch library
pages: Readers may keep a Lark atlas for 14 days. The loan desk records the due date on a yellow slip.
Renewals at Lark are available by telephone. Returning a book is also possible at the street hatch.
Lark repair requests go to the binding desk. Each request includes a shelf mark and a short description.
Lark charges 6 credits for a replacement library card. Updating a mailing address is free.

wren.title: Wren branch library
pages: A Wren atlas is due after 21 days. Periodicals must stay in the reading room.
Wren renewals require the online form. Desk staff can look up the original loan number.
Books needing repair at Wren travel to the conservation room. Place a red slip inside the cover.
At Wren, a replacement library card costs 9 credits. The old card is removed from the active list.

juniper.title: Juniper rehearsal studio
pages: Juniper holds an unpaid booking for 36 hours. After that the room returns to the calendar.
Juniper performers collect keys from the west kiosk. The studio door has no key dispenser.
A Juniper cancellation qualifies for credit with 3 days of notice. An exchange uses the original booking number.
The Juniper piano room admits 8 performers. Instrument cases must stay beneath the benches.

maple.title: Maple rehearsal studio
pages: Maple keeps an unpaid reservation for 12 hours. The coordinator releases unused slots each morning.
Maple room keys await collection at the north booth. A reservation name is needed for pickup.
Maple grants cancellation credit with 5 days of notice. The credit remains attached to the booking account.
The Maple piano room admits 11 performers. Large cases belong on the marked shelf.

amber.title: Amber market stall guide
pages: Amber vendors finish unloading by 07:40. Shoppers enter through a different gate.
At Amber, spare stall signs are stored in the linen shed. The map board shows the shed location.
Amber refunds a stall bond within 8 business days after inspection. The finance clerk records the transfer.
Amber vendors report a broken table to the setup captain. Folded tables belong on the rack.

birch.title: Birch market stall guide
pages: Birch vendors must unload by 08:15. Empty carts line up along the wall.
Spare Birch stall signs are kept in the clock shed. A vendor can request one during setup.
The Birch stall bond is returned within 4 business days after inspection. Keep the inspection receipt.
At Birch, broken tables are reported to the yard steward. Leave the inventory label attached.

cedar.title: Cedar archive procedures
pages: Cedar keeps visitor slips for 18 months. The slips are filed by visit date.
Cedar map copies are requested on the blue worksheet. The catalogue reference goes on the top line.
The Cedar reading room allows 3 folders on one desk. Return each folder before requesting a fourth.
Cedar digitization requests are reviewed on Tuesdays. Staff record the decision in the request book.

elm.title: Elm archive procedures
pages: Elm retains visitor slips for 6 months. Paper slips are arranged by visit date.
For an Elm map copy, submit the green worksheet. Staff return incomplete submissions to the reader.
The Elm reading room permits 2 folders per desk. All other folders stay on the trolley.
Elm digitization requests receive review on Fridays. Completed reviews appear in the request book.

opal.title: Opal repair cafe
pages: An Opal repair appointment lasts 35 minutes. Check in at the welcome table before taking a seat.
Opal labels unfinished items with a silver tag. The tracking number is copied to the visitor slip.
At Opal, uncollected items stay for 16 days. The clerk records the intake date on the label.
Opal schedules volunteer orientation in the east loft. New volunteers receive the tool checklist there.

pearl.title: Pearl repair cafe
pages: Each Pearl repair appointment lasts 50 minutes. The waiting list is held at the welcome table.
Pearl identifies unfinished items with a copper tag. The owner receives a matching claim slip.
Pearl stores uncollected items for 24 days. The counter ledger lists the date each item arrived.
Pearl holds volunteer orientation in the river annex. Checklists are distributed at the first session.
